crossRefs.note: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might…

parallels.note: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.

people.name: Baasha
people.line: Third king of Israel who ruled for 24 years.

people.name: Ramah
people.line: A town in Benjamin, near Gibeah and Jerusalem

translations.web: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.
translations.bsb: When Baasha learned of this, he stopped fortifying Ramah and abandoned his work.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building Ramah, and let his work cease.
